    Finite module control windows up to isomorphism #

    Local representation-finiteness makes the symmetric Hom neighborhood of an indecomposable finite module finite up to isomorphism. Iterating this construction gives the manuscript's finite three-step control window. The actual set-valued window is the isomorphism closure of a finite family; this distinguishes correctly between finiteness of indecomposable isomorphism classes and literal finiteness of the ambient type of module objects.
